tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything. Warm white, never pure white, so white cards lift off it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs, the bottom nav and calendar cells marked Unknown.

tokens.name: peach-50
tokens.usage: Sunken areas: the read-only invite link field, out-of-range calendar days, skeleton loaders.

tokens.name: peach-100
tokens.usage: Soft orange tint: the active bottom-nav pill, info banners, the Confirmed card, Avatar circles, the orange Pill.

tokens.name: peach-200
tokens.usage: Pressed/hover tint for quiet orange things; decorative blocks. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: THE brand fill and the colour of a decided trip: primary Button, the floating create button, the Confirmed card border, the solid Pill (ยืนยันแล้ว / ผู้จัด), the confirmed StatusIcon (Ticket). Text and icons on it are on-orange, never white (white fails contrast).

tokens.name: orange-deep
tokens.usage: The 3px 'candy lip' under a primary Button and the pressed fill. Not for text.

tokens.name: orange-ink
tokens.usage: Orange as text, icon or ring: links, active nav label, the Confirmed ring on calendar days, the sparkle on the best SuggestionCard, the focus ring. On cream, surface, peach-50 and peach-100.

tokens.name: on-orange
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an orange or orange-deep fill (7.0:1 on orange), including the Ticket in the confirmed StatusIcon.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: titles, body, day numbers. On cream, surface, every peach and every -soft tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates under a trip title, hints, legends, Unknown counts. The icon colour of the finding / calendar StatusIcon (5.4:1 on sand) and the pending one. On cream, surface, sand, peach-50, peach-100 and the -soft tints (min 5.4:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card borders, dividers, the calendar grid. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control edges that must be seen (3:1 on surface and cream): input borders, checkbox boxes, the dashed border of an Unknown day, secondary Button border.

tokens.name: free
tokens.usage: Free (ว่าง) / Available. A teal leaning to blue so it never reads as a red–green pair with busy. As text on surface, cream and free-soft; the Check in the free StatusIcon; as a fill under on-status.

tokens.name: free-soft
tokens.usage: Background of my own Free day in a calendar and of the free StatusIcon circle; success banners (saved, copied). Availability only — the Confirmed trip is orange.

tokens.name: free-line
tokens.usage: Border of a Free day cell and free-soft cards (decorative; the Check icon and the word carry the meaning).

tokens.name: busy
tokens.usage: Busy (ไม่ว่าง) in calendars (day numbers, hatched cells, the square Initials badge) and destructive text. As text on surface, cream and busy-soft; as a fill under on-status. The busy StatusIcon is quiet grey instead (mist).

tokens.name: busy-soft
tokens.usage: Background of my own Busy day (with the hatch), error banners.

tokens.name: busy-line
tokens.usage: Border and hatch strokes of a Busy day cell (decorative).

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Light grey circle of the busy StatusIcon (X) and the selected ไม่ว่าง option in StatusPicker. Decorative: the X icon carries the meaning.

tokens.name: mist-line
tokens.usage: The lip under the selected ไม่ว่าง option in StatusPicker.

tokens.name: mist-ink
tokens.usage: The X in the busy StatusIcon and the label of the selected ไม่ว่าง option (5.7:1 on mist, 7.0:1 on surface).

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Soft beige circle of the finding (CalendarClock) and calendar (Calendar) StatusIcons: the trip is still looking for dates, or nothing is here yet. Icon in ink-muted (5.4:1).

tokens.name: on-status
tokens.usage: Text on a free or busy fill: the friend Initials badges in calendar cells (5.7:1 on both).

tokens.name: honey-soft
tokens.usage: Gentle 'heads-up' banners: re-sync and re-push prompts. Never for errors.

tokens.name: honey-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons inside a honey-soft banner (6.2:1).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and error text (ลบทริป, ออกจากทริป, failed saves) — an alias of busy.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour — an alias of orange-ink; see the focus-ring shadow.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimmed backdrop behind an open Sheet (ink at 40%).

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Mitr: round, chunky and friendly in Thai and Latin. Headings, numbers and the wordmark only. Thai needs tall lines for stacked vowels and tone marks, so leading stays at 1.4 or more.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: ทริปของฉัน
styles.usage: One per screen: the page title (ทริปของฉัน, ปฏิทินของฉัน).

styles.name: title
styles.sample: ทะเลกันมั้ย แก๊ง
styles.usage: A trip's title on its own screen and on the Join screen; Sheet titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: ช่วงวันที่แนะนำ
styles.usage: Section headings inside a screen; TripCard titles.

styles.name: day-number
styles.usage: The date number in a calendar DayCell.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big numbers: how many are Available in a window, the rank on the best SuggestionCard.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Anuphan: a loopless Thai that stays crisp at small sizes. 16px body so iOS never zooms into inputs.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: กดวันเพื่อตั้งวันของฉัน แล้วดูว่าใครว่างบ้าง

styles.name: body-strong
styles.sample: เลือกได้ 1–20 ธ.ค. · ไป 3 วัน
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body copy; Banner first line; Button labels.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: ว่าง 4 · ติด 1 · ยังไม่ระบุ 1
styles.usage: Metadata under titles, hints under inputs, counts, legends.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: ผู้จัด · แขก · กำลังหาวัน
styles.usage: StatusPill labels, weekday headers, bottom-nav labels.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Two-letter friend Initials inside calendar cells. Nothing else is this small.

spacing.note: 4px base. The page gutter on phones is space-4; sections stack at space-6.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between calendar cells and between Initials badges in a cell; icon-to-label in a pill.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and pills; gap between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows; card internal gaps; Banner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on phones; card padding; Sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on the hero cards (Confirmed, best suggestion).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of a screen to its title; EmptyState vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target height; calendar cell min-height on the personal calendar.

radius.note: Soft and round everywhere: nothing on screen has a sharp corner.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: A busy friend's Initials badge in a calendar cell: squarer than the round free badge, so the two differ in shape, not only colour.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkbox, small chips, the rank chip on a SuggestionCard.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, calendar DayCells, Banners.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards (TripCard, SuggestionCard, InviteLinkBox).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Top corners of a Sheet; the bottom nav bar.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, MemberChips, StatusIcon circles, free Initials badges, the active nav pill.

shadow.note: Warm, low shadows tinted with ink. The candy lip is the brand's one tactile flourish.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest on cream.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Floating things: the bottom nav, a Sheet, the floating create button.

tokens.name: shadow-lip
tokens.usage: The 3px orange-deep 'candy lip' under a primary Button; on press it drops to 1px while the button moves down 2px.

tokens.name: shadow-lip-quiet
tokens.usage: The same lip in line colour under a secondary Button and StatusPicker segments.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px cream gap, then 2px of solid orange-ink (5.6:1 on cream). Applied as box-shadow so it follows the radius.

duration.note: Short and springy. Fun comes from a small overshoot, not from length.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Press feedback on buttons and cells.

tokens.name: duration-pop
tokens.usage: A DayCell or StatusPicker changing state (scale 0.92 → 1.04 → 1 on ease-pop).

tokens.name: duration-sheet
tokens.usage: A Sheet sliding up; Banner entering.

tokens.name: ease-pop
tokens.usage: The gentle overshoot used when something changes state (a mark is set, a link copied).

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Sheets and banners entering; anything that should settle, not bounce.

layout.note: Breakpoints and column widths for phone, tablet, PC and dual-screen. Measured on the app's own width (CSS container queries), not the device name. CSS can't read var() inside a query, so bundle.css and AppShell repeat 600px and 1024px.

tokens.name: bp-medium
tokens.usage: From here the medium layout: nav rail instead of the bottom nav, centred dialogs, day panel floating above the bottom. iPad mini/Air/Pro portrait (744–1024), unfolded foldables, iPhone in landscape.

tokens.name: bp-expanded
tokens.usage: From here the expanded layout: sidebar with recent trips, pages split into main + aside, day panel as a right-hand drawer. iPad landscape, laptops and PCs.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: The medium layout's left nav rail: create button, two tabs with labels, avatar.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: The expanded layout's sidebar: wordmark, สร้างทริป, tabs, recent trips, the user.

tokens.name: aside-width
tokens.usage: The right column on expanded pages (suggested windows, members, invite link); the day drawer is this plus space-8.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Single-column reading width on medium screens; the calendar on a tablet in portrait is this wide.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: The widest a page gets on a PC; past it the page centres on cream.
